portion.hint: What the kitchen weighs or counts out for one portion.
portion.perPackHint: e.g. a 1 kg pack of chicken = 6 portions. Used to suggest how many packs to buy.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.hint: Kitchen stock, counted in portions. Recipes use these when a dish is sold.
ingredients.caption: Ingredients
ingredients.ledgerHint: Ingredients are on the same stock ledger as everything else: receive them on a purchase order, count or adjust them in Inventory, and open one to see every movement.

ingredient.dialogHint: Stock-only: it's never sold on the POS.
ingredient.unitHint: Portions for the customer's kitchen way of working; pieces for things like eggs.
ingredient.minimumHint: Low-stock alert at or below this.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.hint: What one plate of each dish uses. A dish with a recipe is made to order: selling it takes its ingredients from kitchen stock.
recipes.caption: Recipes
recipes.canMakeHint: "Can make" is what the scarcest ingredient allows at {{location}}, plus prepared plates ready to resell.
recipes.withoutHint: These are tracked as finished stock (counted as made or bought).
recipes.allHaveRecipes: Every item sold here has a recipe

form.title: Recipe
form.deductOn: On — the dish is made to order
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. One chicken portion per plate
form.previewEmpty: Add ingredients to see how many can be made.
form.plusPrepared_one: Plus {{count}} prepared plate ready to resell.
form.plusPrepared_other: Plus {{count}} prepared plates ready to resell.
form.pausedHint: Sales won't touch the ingredients; the dish is counted as finished stock again.

portions.title: Portions & planning
portions.hint: Define what a portion is, then work out today's ingredient needs from expected sales.

planner.title: Today's requirement
planner.hint: Expected plates × recipes, against what's in the kitchen at {{location}}.
planner.enough: There's enough in the kitchen for the expected sales.
planner.noRecipes: Add recipes to plan ingredient needs

prepared.title: Prepared items
prepared.hint: Cooked food at {{location}} waiting to be resold. The next order for the same item uses it before cooking a new one.
prepared.addHint: Food cooked ahead or made extra, ready to sell.
prepared.usesIngredients: Made to order: its ingredients are taken from stock now.
prepared.finishedItem: Tracked as finished stock: nothing moves until it's sold or disposed of.

flow.nextOrder: Next order for it uses it
flow.orDispose: Or dispose of it with a reason

dispose.hint: It can't be resold. Say what happened to it — this goes in the audit log.
dispose.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Past its time, not safe to serve
